snippet.title: CitaDrill - The 1-Bit-inspired Roguelike City-Builder - Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 Now Hiring: Remote Drill Operators! 🚨

Wrestling with an ever-present urge to dig? Craving a creepy, somewhat absurd, high-stress experience? Then you should dive into CitaDrill— a 1-bit-inspired roguelike city-builder in motion! 

Manage an ever-moving drill full of 'copycats': build structures, assign workers to modules, and balance resources to keep your drill running while adapting to ever-changing environments. You'll venture into hazardous biomes to gather materials, uncover secrets, and fend off dangerous subterranean creatures. Every decision matters—expand strategically, defend your crew, and push your expedition as far as possible before starting anew.

No experience? No problem! C.A.T., your drill's trusty operating system, will be there to 'help' you (when the mood strikes it). 

Wishlist now on Steam! 🚀
